description: The Agent Exchange router: one question, the best live x402 endpoints for that need, ranked by on-chain payers then price, re-probed hourly. Each answer carries url, method, price_usd, network, payers, settled_usd and the seller page. Free, no signup. To use an answer: GET its url unpaid, read the 402 payment ask, pay the payTo in USDC on Base (x402), retry: delivery at once.
